plan.title: Single-stage RFP required T&C blocks vendor submission

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Keep the event type as RFP.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Choose the questionnaire template for the RFP.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Complete the technical questionnaire setup.
Assign the evaluator required for an RFP.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add clauses named "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set Payment within 45 days to Required, leave Delivery within 7 days set to None, click Done, and stop on the create screen showing the configured terms.

steps.note: Configure the required and optional event clauses, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Invite one QA vendor for the vendor-side submission test.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFP.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's technical submission screen as the vendor.
Verify the required clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the optional clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept only the optional clause.
Ensure the required clause remains unaccepted before the negative submission attempt.
Attempt submission with the required clause unchecked; the application must refuse it.
Confirm the required clause remains identified on the blocked submission screen.
Confirm the vendor submission was not sent.
Accept the required clause after the blocked attempt.
Submit the technical response after both clauses are accepted.
Verify that the vendor submission succeeds once the required clause is accepted.
